expected.name: Martin Gunderson
expected.description: Martin Gunderson was a Norwegian immigrant and Industrial Workers of the World member in Aberdeen, South Dakota. A federal jury convicted him of conspiracy over the mailing of phosphorus and potassium cyanide. He was sentenced on November 21, 1917, to two years in federal prison and a $1,000 fine. Federal authorities released him from Leavenworth on August 3, 1919, immediately detained him for deportation, and deported him to Norway on September 4, 1919.
